biggest_gap: Nothing in this build can tell an honest map from a completely forged one, because every compliance number it reports is derived from the model being audited - and the forgery now works through the player's own save file, sealed by the game's own writer. None of round 1's three remedies has landed.
remedies: Publish the audit restore() already computes: carry stood_cells/phantom_cells/missing_cells/legacy onto sim and surface them through mapState() and getUIState().map. save/state.js:676 currently keeps only .dropped.
Point map-probe L3 at the field that is read: forge world.discovery.stood in the wire format (critic-map-r2.mjs forgeTrail() is 9 lines) and give it a --break forge self-test.
Corroborate the footprint against engine.js's travel.visited, written by a different system. NOT ISOLATED: coverage unverified, same gap as round 1.
Freeze the slot: Object.defineProperty(sim, 'discovery', {value: d, writable: false, configurable: false}). One line, closes Q1/Q2/Q3.
Say what the seal is. exchange.js's sha-256 is an integrity check, not an authenticity check; a map that trusts exactly one field wants a keyed check or an out-of-band corroborator.
